# Resilience drills (generated by `scripts/chaos/run_all.sh`)

Run started 2026-11-23T22:11:44Z against the live stack. Every drill injects a real failure, then measures from
`/api/system/status` (what the operator sees) how many seconds until the platform **detected** it, checks the
automatic mitigation, and how many seconds until it **recovered with no human action**.

**Result: 11 / 11 drills passed.**

| # | Failure injected | Detected after (s) | Automatic mitigation (measured) | Recovered after (s) | Result | Note |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| F1 | Simulator unavailable (503) 75s | 2.8 | breaker OPEN; cached state served (HTTP 200, 63.93s old); SAFE_HOLD after 61.4s; no writes | 25.2 | **PASS** | recover counted from fault expiry |
| F2 | Simulator error rate 0.5 for 60s | 9.1 | retries + last-good per resource; ticks advanced 588->594; failed allocations 0->0 | 17.6 | **PASS** | recover counted from fault expiry |
| F3 | Simulator latency 2500ms for 45s | 6.9 | 2 s timeout counts as failure; nothing written on old data (slow: p95 2002 ms) | 22.9 | **PASS** | recover counted from fault expiry |
| F4 | Simulator stale_data for 45s | 2.7 | state.stale=true, engine DEGRADED: autopilot paused, approvals 409 STALE_DATA | 0.0 | **PASS** | recover counted from fault expiry |
| F5 | SSE refused 60s (+ forced reconnect) | 2.2 | polling fallback kept ticks moving 678->683; reconnect with backoff | 1.1 | **PASS** | detect includes the engine boot; recover counted from fault expiry |
| F6 | Malformed /v1/stations (wrong_type) | 1.1 | payload rejected, last-good kept, quarantine rows 32->48; shown: invalid stations: 0.inventory: Value error, must be an object keyed by fuel type | 2.6 | **PASS** | recover counted from clearing the corruption |
| F7 | Prediction service stopped 40s | 3.8 | forecast source=fallback (seasonal fallback); confidence 0.6 so a human reviews | 11.1 | **PASS** | recover counted from container start |
| F9 | Database stopped 30s | 4.3 | engine kept running (tick 760->773); 32 writes buffered, flushed after restart | 4.3 | **PASS** | recover counted from container start |
| F10 | Redis stopped 30s | 2.3 | api served live state from the engine (HTTP 200, tick 780->795) | 3.2 | **PASS** | recover counted from container start |
| F11 | Engine killed (SIGKILL), restarted | 2.0 | state rebuilt from simulator + DB; duplicate idempotency keys after restart: 0 | 2.8 | **PASS** | recover counted from container start |
| F15 | Simulator reset | 0.6 | new sim_run #55 -> #56; live state cleared, history kept | 0.0 | **PASS** |  |

Health is judged from real traffic (breaker state, error ratio and p95 of the last 30 s, the stale header),
never from the simulator's `/v1/health`, which bypasses fault injection. Incidents with detect / mitigate /
recover timestamps: `GET /api/incidents` and the System Health page.
